Step 1 is committed as `17c696fa6`. The subpage tools now only append lines to the parent's `page.jsonl`; they never edit a `page.js`. I haven't tested it against the live server or run `check_page` on `/live/`, because that needs a Servex restart.

- **What changed:** `Servex/agents/Subpages.js` handles add, rename and remove. Each now appends a `file` or `gone` line to the parent's `page.jsonl`, and creates that file if the parent doesn't have one. `create_page` uses it, and I updated its description in `Servex/pages.js` to match.
- **What I tested:** I ran an add against a scratch copy of `/live/`. It made the child folder and the `{file}` line, and the copy's `page.js` came out byte-identical.
- **What's still open:** I haven't confirmed that a `page.js` parent shows children that are listed only in its `page.jsonl`. That is the navigation question from your step 5.
- **When it takes effect:** the change goes live after the next Servex restart. I haven't restarted it, per your rule about the voice call.

I haven't started steps 2–5 (storage variants doc, deep deltas, parent as template, navigation question).

Before the fix, `/live` (a `page.js` parent) did not route a child listed only in its `page.jsonl`. After the fix it does. The fix is committed as `645ccbe33` and needs no restart.

- **The test:** I made a throwaway `page.js` parent with a child named only in its `page.jsonl` and loaded it headlessly. The child gave a 404 before the fix and rendered after it. I removed the probe files afterwards. I tested on a scratch parent, not on `/live` itself.
- **The cause:** `Page.child()` in `core/Page/Page.class.js` only read a folder's listing if something else had already fetched it. The `page.jsonl` and `files.jsonl` lists were never fetched for a plain `page.js` page.
- **The fix:** one line, `await Page.listing(this.url)`, before the listing is read.
- **Regression check:** `/live/` and `/framework/core/Page/jsonl/` still load.
- **Still open:** I only checked that the child routes and renders. Whether it shows up in the sidebar nav is untested.
- **Also done:** I fixed the stray indent on the `mkdirSync` line in `add()`, as you asked, in the same commit.

Next is step 2, the storage variants doc.

The file and shell tools are built and merged to `michael/dev`, and `node Servex/ext/remote/RemoteMCP.test.mjs` passes. They don't load until Servex restarts, and I didn't restart it because of the call. I didn't post this on the card or log it in `task.jsonl`.

- **Tools:** `read_file`, `write_file`, `edit_file`, `list_dir`, `glob` and `shell` are in the shared registry (`Servex/files.js`). `shell` runs Git Bash by default or PowerShell, with a timeout and exit code. All six take an optional `root`, a worktree name or a full path, and default to the monorepo.
- **JSONL:** `write_file` and `edit_file` refuse any `.jsonl` file and point at `.claude/hooks/append.mjs`.
- **Fewer approvals:** I added a generic `call({tool, args})` tool whose schema never changes, so tools added later should be reachable without a new approval. `call({tool:"list"})` returns every tool with its schema. I couldn't test whether the Claude app re-asks approval when the tool list changes, so that part is still unknown. A `list_changed` notification isn't possible because the endpoint has no stream to send it on.
- **Doc:** `Servex/ext/remote/doc/remote-tools.md`, linked from the remote readme.
- **Coordination:** I couldn't message helper-tool-collapse (the tool refused). My only edits to shared code are two lines in `Servex/agents/Global.js`, so a conflict with its reshaping should be easy to spot.

I'm blocked on the first step because my git and Servex permissions are missing. I haven't written or committed anything.

- **Worktree:** `git worktree add`, `git merge --ff-only` and `git reset` all need approval. `EnterWorktree` did work, but it branched from the old `origin/main`, 3,973 commits behind `michael/dev`.
- **Servex tools:** `take_worktree` and `page_log` aren't granted either, so I can't post progress lines.

I don't want to write the plan in the main checkout, because it has uncommitted changes, or on the stale branch.

Please do either of these and I'll continue:
- Approve `git merge --ff-only michael/dev` in `.claude/worktrees/handover-query`, plus commits.
- Allow `take_worktree` and `page_log`.

The research is done, so I can write all five steps quickly once I can commit. I read `SessionIndex`, `FollowUp`, `ext/Query` and the TaskLoop doc. They show that `SessionIndex` already watches `task.jsonl` live. The stale thing is probably the per-day `index.json`, or `follow-up.md`, which is only rebuilt once a day. I'll confirm which in step 1.

Step 1 is written, but it isn't logged to `task.jsonl` and the mastermind hasn't been told. I couldn't reach `mastermind-voice-20261016`, and none of the listed peers match its name. I stopped there because you asked for review after each step.

Step 1 is in `public/framework/ai/doc/handover-query.md` in the `handover-query` worktree, with a link line in `ai/readme.md`. It isn't committed.

- **Cause:** the live tasks index (`Server/SessionIndex.mjs`) relies on `fs.watch` alone. It has no periodic sweep and no error handler, unlike the session index's 5-second sweep. `past-work-index.md` has no scheduler at all, so it is the likeliest source of the "6 days".
- **Fix:** have `SessionIndex.query` re-check every `task.jsonl` file's size at most every 30 seconds and read any that changed. The watcher stays, and the doc says why I rejected a timed rebuild.
- **Not measured:** I couldn't run node, so I haven't confirmed which index was actually stale. The doc names the check.
- **Not logged:** `append.mjs` and a temp-file write both need approval. The log line is ready to append once you approve node and the temp write, or someone with approval can append it.

Say when to continue with step 2 (the Query calls for open and in-flight items, high-priority flags and latest per topic).

Steps 2 to 5 are written in `public/framework/ai/doc/handover-query.md` in the `handover-query` worktree, with a short "What the owner sees" section at the top. I couldn't message `mastermind-voice-20261016` (it isn't reachable), so nothing from steps 2 to 5 is committed or logged yet.

I haven't confirmed whether the 6-day staleness really came from the live index (I couldn't run node). The doc names the check.

- **Step 2:** There are five small queries over the existing `tasks` source: open, in-flight, high priority, latest per topic, and the week/month summaries. Three readers disagree on "done", so the plan adopts the task loop's rule (a landing line with an outcome, or `closed_by`). It also adds a few missing fields: `open`/`state`, `priority`, a derived `topic`, `now`, `parent`.
- **Step 3:** The existing task loop and the stop hook already nag. The plan adds one `Handover` class that everything calls, a nag for old open tasks whose agent is gone, and a start-of-session hook that prints the handover digest.
- **Step 4:** `handover.md` shrinks to a fixed stub, because CLAUDE.md and many docs name that path. The old text moves aside by script. The page gets Day / Week / Month chips, and the Dashboard's `DAYS` goes from 7 to 30.
- **Step 5:** Recommend not renaming `task.jsonl`. It has 623 mentions across 249 JS files, `session.jsonl` is already a different file, and one session can write to many tasks.

Please commit the worktree and log steps 2 to 5.

Status: steps 1, 5 and 2 are done and committed (`17c696fa6`, `645ccbe33`, `7b9e2f32f`).

- **Step 5:** a `page.js` parent didn't route a child listed only in its `page.jsonl`. A one-line fix in `Page.child()` made it route and render, checked headlessly on a scratch parent. Whether such a child shows in the sidebar nav is untested.
- **Step 2:** `core/Page/doc/subpages.md` now describes the two storage variants. It is linked from the Page readme and from `ai-api.md`.
- **Restart:** step 1's change reaches the live server only after the next Servex restart, which I haven't done.

I'm on step 3 now: the deep-delta proposal, reading `Servex/agents/page_tools.js`. I'll write the proposal into the doc first and build only the smallest slice. Step 4 follows.

Understood. The plan is in `public/framework/ai/doc/handover-query.md`, merged as `376f792f7`. I've stopped and built nothing.

All five steps are done and committed. I haven't merged or restarted Servex.

- **Step 1:** subpage tools only append lines to the parent's `page.jsonl` and never edit a `page.js` (`17c696fa6`). It takes effect on the next Servex restart, and I haven't run `check_page` on `/live/` for the same reason.
- **Step 5:** a `page.js` parent returned a 404 for a child listed only in its `page.jsonl`. One line in `Page.child()` fixed it (`645ccbe33`), checked on a scratch parent. I didn't check whether such a child shows in the sidebar nav; that is written down as an open question.
- **Step 2:** `core/Page/doc/subpages.md` covers the two storage variants, embedded and referenced (`7b9e2f32f`). The Page readme and `ai-api.md` link to it.
- **Step 3:** the doc states the deep-delta rule: pass only what changed, at any depth. The built slice is `deep_merge` in the `page_read` replay (`e6d98e579`), so `page_read` matches what a deep line describes. That also needs a restart. The same merge for the browser-side `Item.set_one` is proposed but not built, because it changes the core class every page uses.
- **Step 4:** `Template.clone` and `copy` exist, but only on `Template`, not on `Page` (`b51eea0c0`). A child can use its parent as a template only when the parent is a `Template`. Doing it from a `page.jsonl` line isn't built; I left it as a decision for you.

I'm finished and idle. The plan is merged as `376f792f7` and logged in `task.jsonl`. The mastermind told me to stop and build nothing until you've seen it. The task has no landing line yet, which is probably why the loop keeps checking.
